def snap(fr):
    d={}

def snap(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        if n['color'] in ('W','c','N'):
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return d
